title: Puppy eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- puppy body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='66' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#d99b52'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='74' rx='17' ry='11' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='82' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#c98840'/>
  <!-- front paws -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='84' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='85' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M70 62 Q82 52 76 44 Q73 41 69 45 Q74 50 66 58 Z' fill='#d99b52'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='20' fill='#e0a85c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='34' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#b57430' transform='rotate(-20 20 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='32' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#b57430' transform='rotate(20 56 32)'/>
  <!-- ear inner -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='35' rx='3' ry='7' fill='#8a5424' transform='rotate(-20 21 35)'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='33' rx='3' ry='7' fill='#8a5424' transform='rotate(20 55 33)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='52' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#5b3a1a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#5b3a1a'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#fff3dd'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#fff3dd'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='48' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#6b3f1b'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M34 53 Q38 58 42 53' stroke='#8a5424' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='58' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#e8798a'/>
  <!-- snack (biscuit) held at mouth -->
  <rect x='44' y='55' width='13' height='9' rx='3' fill='#d9a743' transform='rotate(-18 50 59)'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#a8761f'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#a8761f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='1.2' fill='#a8761f'/>
  <!-- front arm to snack -->
  <path d='M30 74 Q40 70 46 62' stroke='#e0a85c' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
